<thought>Analyzing the spectrum shows a clear series of peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da, which is the characteristic spacing of ¹³C isotopes relative to ¹²C. This pattern allows us to definitively identify carbon in the sample. No other element shows a distinctive isotopic spacing (e.g., the ~2 Da spacing of Cl, Br, or S does not match their characteristic intensity ratios), so only carbon can be confirmed.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
